info.title: CeDesk API
info.description: Help desk backend: tickets, routing, SLA, macros and rules.

post.summary: Sign in with workspace address, email and password

post.summary: Email me a link to choose a new password
post.description: Always 202, whether or not the workspace and email exist, so it can't be used to find accounts. The link lasts 30 minutes; at most 3 are sent per hour.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Optional, any unique string (a UUID is good), up to 255 characters. Send the same key when you retry: a repeat returns what the first request made (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of making it twice. The same key with a different request is 422. Keys last 24 hours, per member.

post.description: The request body is the file itself (not a form), with its type in `Content-Type`, for example `fetch(url, {method: 'POST', body: file, headers: {'Content-Type': file.type}})`. At most 25 MB by default (`CEDESK_ATTACHMENT_MAX_BYTES`): 413 above.

get.description: Ask again for a new link once it expires (5 minutes by default). 409 when the file failed the virus scan, or (with scanning on) is still being checked.

get.summary: Admin: emails that could not be sent after every retry

post.summary: Admin: send a failed email again
post.description: It goes back in the queue (tries from zero) and the worker sends it within seconds; its ticket gets a line saying who did it. 404 if it isn't failed or can't be retried (account emails).

post.summary: A mail service delivers one incoming email (token required)

put.summary: Admin: change the first-reply and resolve targets per priority
put.description: Only the priorities sent change. The first reply can't be due after the resolution (422). Every open ticket's SLA is worked out again.

get.summary: Admin: events that could not be delivered after every retry

post.summary: Admin: try a failed event again now
post.description: Its tries start from zero. Steps that already worked are not repeated.

503.description: The database did not answer within 2 seconds

password.title: Password
password.description: A first password the member changes later.

status.description: None for light agents: they have no status.

cap_overrides.title: Cap Overrides
cap_overrides.description: Channels where this agent has their own limit; the rest follow the workspace default.

message_id.title: Message Id
message_id.description: The reply or note it was sent with, if any.

scan_status.title: Scan Status
scan_status.description: not_scanned, clean, infected, or scan_failed (could not be checked). With virus scanning on, only clean files can be downloaded.

new_password.title: New Password
new_password.description: 10 to 128 characters, not the current one.

url.title: Url
url.description: Opens the file without signing in, until `expires_at`.

address.title: Address
address.description: e.g. support@acme.in. Stored lower-case; unique across all workspaces.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown as the sender, e.g. 'Acme Support'.

signature.title: Signature
signature.description: Added under every reply from this address. Placeholders such as {{agent.name}} are filled when the reply is sent.

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: Replies come from it when the customer wrote elsewhere. The first address is always the default.

anyOf.description: Shown as the sender, e.g. 'Acme Support'.
Added under every reply from this address. Placeholders such as {{agent.name}} are filled when the reply is sent.

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: Only `true`: make another address the default to move it.

can_retry.title: Can Retry
can_retry.description: false for account emails: their text is removed when they fail. The person asks for a new link instead.

key.title: Key
key.description: Stored on tickets: a-z, 0-9 and _, starting with a letter.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Send as `cursor` for the next page.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Run in order. Each is one of: {"kind": "reply", "text": "Hi {{customer.first_name}}, ..."} (placeholders are filled when it runs); {"kind": "note", "text": "..."}; {"kind": "set_status", "status": "resolved"}; {"kind": "set_priority", "priority": "low"}; {"kind": "set_team", "team_id": "..."} (re-routes the ticket); {"kind": "add_tag", "tag": "refund"}. At most one reply and one note.

ids.title: Ids
ids.description: Every macro id, in the new order.

position.title: Position
position.description: The order in the Macros menu, lowest first.

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: What to fix, e.g. the team it sets was deleted. Empty when fine.

anyOf.description: Run in order. Each is one of: {"kind": "reply", "text": "Hi {{customer.first_name}}, ..."} (placeholders are filled when it runs); {"kind": "note", "text": "..."}; {"kind": "set_status", "status": "resolved"}; {"kind": "set_priority", "priority": "low"}; {"kind": "set_team", "team_id": "..."} (re-routes the ticket); {"kind": "add_tag", "tag": "refund"}. At most one reply and one note.

next_after.title: Next After
next_after.description: Pass as `after` for the next page.

scan_status.title: Scan Status
scan_status.description: not_scanned, clean, infected, or scan_failed (could not be checked).

kind.description: reply: to the customer. note: team only.

body.title: Body
body.description: Replies fill {{customer.first_name}}, {{customer.name}}, {{agent.name}} and {{fields.<key>}} ("—" when empty). May be empty only when sending files.

attachment_ids.title: Attachment Ids
attachment_ids.description: Files to send with it: upload each to the ticket first (POST /tickets/{id}/attachments), then list their ids here. Only your own files not sent yet. With files, `body` may be empty.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email messages: from, to, cc, message_id.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Files sent with it (by the agent, or in the customer's email).

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: Replies on email tickets: whether the email went out. pending: queued or retrying; sent; failed: gave up (see the ticket's system line).

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: created: a new ticket; added / rules_ran / reopened / thanked: on an existing ticket; the rest: ignored on purpose.

ids.title: Ids
ids.description: Every ticket type id, in the new order.

new_password.title: New Password
new_password.description: 10 to 128 characters. Give it to the member; they can change it later.

token.title: Token
token.description: From the link in the email: the part after `#token=`.

cap_email.title: Cap Email
cap_email.description: null: follow the workspace default again.

cap_chat.title: Cap Chat
cap_chat.description: null: follow the workspace default again.

cap_messaging.title: Cap Messaging
cap_messaging.description: null: follow the workspace default again.

event.title: Event
event.description: created: a new ticket. customer_replied: the customer wrote on an Open or Pending ticket. Agent edits never run rules.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: All must match. Each is one of: {"kind": "text_contains_any", "words": ["refund"]} (subject and customer messages, any case); {"kind": "channel_in", "channels": ["email"]}; {"kind": "to_address_contains", "text": "billing@"}; {"kind": "status_in", "statuses": ["pending"]}; {"kind": "sentiment_in", "sentiments": ["negative"]}.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Run in order. Each is one of: {"kind": "set_type", "type_id": "...", "only_if_empty": false}; {"kind": "set_team", "team_id": "..."}; {"kind": "set_priority", "priority": "high", "keep_urgent": true}; {"kind": "set_status", "status": "open"}; {"kind": "add_tag", "tag": "upset"}.

ids.title: Ids
ids.description: Every rule id, in the new order.

position.title: Position
position.description: Rules run in this order, lowest first.

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: What to fix, e.g. the team it sets was deleted. Empty when fine.

anyOf.description: created: a new ticket. customer_replied: the customer wrote on an Open or Pending ticket. Agent edits never run rules.

All must match. Each is one of: {"kind": "text_contains_any", "words": ["refund"]} (subject and customer messages, any case); {"kind": "channel_in", "channels": ["email"]}; {"kind": "to_address_contains", "text": "billing@"}; {"kind": "status_in", "statuses": ["pending"]}; {"kind": "sentiment_in", "sentiments": ["negative"]}.

Run in order. Each is one of: {"kind": "set_type", "type_id": "...", "only_if_empty": false}; {"kind": "set_team", "team_id": "..."}; {"kind": "set_priority", "priority": "high", "keep_urgent": true}; {"kind": "set_status", "status": "open"}; {"kind": "add_tag", "tag": "upset"}.

shortcut.title: Shortcut
shortcut.description: What the agent types after `/`, e.g. `refund`. Stored lower-case.

body.title: Body
body.description: The text. Placeholders such as {{customer.first_name}} are filled when the reply is sent.

shortcut.title: Shortcut
shortcut.description: Without the slash: `refund` is typed as `/refund`.

source.title: Source
source.description: default (came with the workspace), manual, calendly, or an import source such as intercom.

anyOf.description: What the agent types after `/`, e.g. `refund`. Stored lower-case.
The text. Placeholders such as {{customer.first_name}} are filled when the reply is sent.

Sentiment.title: Sentiment
Sentiment.description: Set by triage (keyword rules, Phase 2) or the Cevanos handover.

token.title: Token
token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Shown only once.

stopped_at.title: Stopped At
stopped_at.description: The reply or resolution; null while running.

state.title: State
state.description: close: under 25% of the target left. breached stays after the reply. met: done in time.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: The SLA policy that matched; null: priority targets.

current.title: Current
current.description: The clock the pill shows: first reply until it is replied, then resolve.

state.title: State
state.description: The current clock's state, for the pill.

paused.title: Paused
paused.description: Outside business hours (or a holiday) and still running. Pending does not pause.

SlaOut.title: SlaOut
SlaOut.description: The ticket's SLA, worked out when it is read (W13).

Sort.title: Sort

reads_as.title: Reads As
reads_as.description: The sentence under the row, e.g. 'Urgent tickets get ...'

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: true: never changed by an Admin.

sent_to.title: Sent To
sent_to.description: Your own address; the email is queued, not yet sent.

counts.description: Per status, ignoring the other filters (for the tabs).

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Send as `cursor`, with the same filters and sort, for the next page. null on the last page.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: false: a handover waiting for an agent to accept it.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The latest 50 messages, oldest to newest.

older_messages_cursor.title: Older Messages Cursor
older_messages_cursor.description: Send as `cursor` to GET /tickets/{id}/messages for older messages; null when every message is shown.

TicketPatch.title: TicketPatch
TicketPatch.description: Send only what changes. `null` clears type, team, assignee or one field.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: false: a handover waiting for an agent to accept it.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: The whole new list: add, remove, rename or reorder fields.
